code: library(rslurm)  # Split the rows of the parameter table into contiguous chunks — one per node: n_chunks <- 20 row_splits <- split(   seq_len(nrow(nl@simdesign@siminput)),   cut(seq_len(nrow(nl@simdesign@siminput)), n_chunks, labels = FALSE) )  # One row per chunk, storing its first and last siminput row index: chunks <- data.frame(   first = vapply(row_splits, min, integer(1)),   last  = vapply(row_splits, max, integer(1)) )  # The function executed on each node — runs one chunk of the design. # All random seeds are run for the chunk's parameter rows. sim_fun <- function(first, last) {   library(nlrx)   nl_chunk <- nl   nl_chunk@simdesign@siminput <- nl@simdesign@siminput[first:last, ]   run_nl_all(nl_chunk, block_size = 100, threads = 1) }  sjob <- slurm_apply(   f              = sim_fun,   params         = chunks,   jobname        = "nlrx_sim",   nodes          = nrow(chunks),        # one array task per chunk   cpus_per_node  = 1,                   # raise to match `threads` below   global_objects = "nl",               # ship the nl object to every node   pkgs           = c("nlrx"),   slurm_options  = list(     partition     = "medium",     time          = "01:00:00",     "mem-per-cpu" = "2G"   ),   submit = FALSE                        # create the job scripts without submitting ) results <- get_slurm_out(sjob, outtype = "table")

NetLogo heading system measured degree, ranging 0 359. agent heading = 0 pointing straight top border lattice. order transfer NetLogo heading system ggplot gganimate angle system, conversions need done. type conversion depends geom used plotting. present two examples heading conversion: geom_text can used plot arrows pointing heading agent. geom_text also uses degree angles, however angle 0 means text pointing right edge plotting area. Furthermore, angles counter-clockwise, whereas NetLogo headings defined clockwise direction. case use right-pointing ASCII-arrow geom_text label. Thus, need shift NetLogo headings 90 degree right invert direction multiplying headings -1. geom_spoke can used plot arrows pointing heading agent. geom_spoke uses radians angles. code: ## Output from nlrx simulations: results <- run_nl_all(nl) ## Self-writte output directory: ascdir <- file.path(dirname(nl@modelpath), "output") results.lsm <- purrr::map_dfr(list.files(ascdir, pattern = "asc", full.names = TRUE), function(x) {   x.split <- strsplit(x, "_")[[1]]   x.tick <- as.numeric(strsplit(x.split[[length(x.split)]], "\\.")[[1]][[1]])   x.siminputrow <- as.numeric(x.split[[length(x.split) - 1]][[1]])   x.seed <- as.numeric(x.split[[length(x.split) - 2]][[1]])   x.raster <- raster(x)      ## netlogo asc files use NaN as default nodata value in the asc file header   ## this leads to problems when reading the raster because it sets ´zeros to NA   ## here we set NAs back to zertos manually:   x.raster <- reclassify(x.raster, cbind(NA, 0))      ## Calculate landscape metrics:   metrics <- c("lsm_l_ed", "lsm_l_shdi", "lsm_l_lsi", "lsm_l_lpi", "lsm_l_area_mn")   x.metrics <- landscapemetrics::calculate_lsm(x.raster, what=metrics) %>%      dplyr::select(metric, value) %>%      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from=metric, values_from = value)      x.final <- tibble::tibble(siminputrow = x.siminputrow,                             `[step]` = x.tick,                             `random-seed` = x.seed)      x.final <- cbind(x.final, x.metrics)   return(x.final) }) ## Combine results with lsm and store: results <- results %>% left_join(results.lsm, by = c("siminputrow", "random-seed", "[step]"))  ## Attach output to nl object: setsim(nl, "simoutput") <- results saveRDS(nl, file = file.path(outpath, "my_final_nl_object.rds"))

title: Sensitivity Analysis
text: Different types sensitivity analyses can conducted using nlrx package. perform local sensitivity analysis, recommend using simdesign_distinct() specify local changes parameters. Additionally, output Latin Hypercube Sampling designs (simdesign_lhs()) can used calculate parameter effects based Partial (rank) correlation coefficients Standardised (rank) regression coefficients. vignette, present example Morris Elementary Effects screening. sensitivity analyses simdesigns work quite similar way. text: First, need attach results nl object. results attached, need post-process data run pcc src function sensitivity package. first take parameter matrix (siminput) select columns variable parameters drop columns. also need rename columns pcc src support special characters (-) column names. simulation results measured tick, thus first need aggregate output. just calculate mean standard deviation outputs random-seed siminputrow combination. Afterwards, drop random seed siminputrow columns rename columns remove special characters. Finally, use datasets run pcc src functions. functions can compute coefficients one output time. Thus, nested function call inside purrr::map() function iterates column names output tibble. results reported nested list, outer element represents one calculated model outputs. inner list items represent different outputs pcc src functions. can example look pcc results one specific output using basic plot function: can also extract data tidy data format create nice plots ggplot package:
code: setsim(nl, "simoutput") <- results saveRDS(nl, file.path(nl@experiment@outpath, "lhs.rds")) library(tidyverse) input <- getsim(nl, "siminput") %>%    # Take input parameter matrix   dplyr::select(names(getexp(nl, "variables"))) %>%  # Select variable parameters only   dplyr::rename_all(~str_replace_all(., c("-" = "_", "\\s+" = "_"))) # Remove - and space characters.  output <- getsim(nl, "simoutput") %>%   # Take simulation output   dplyr::group_by(`random-seed`, siminputrow) %>% # Group by random seed and siminputrow   dplyr::summarise_at(getexp(nl, "metrics"), list(mean=mean, sd=sd)) %>% # Aggregate output   dplyr::ungroup() %>%  # Ungroup   dplyr::select(-`random-seed`, -siminputrow) %>%  # Only select metrics   dplyr::rename_all(~str_replace_all(., c("-" = "_", "\\s+" = "_", "\\[" = "_", "\\]" = "_", "=" = ""))) # Remove - and space characters.  # Perform pcc and src for each output separately (map) pcc.result <- purrr::map(names(output), function(x) sensitivity::pcc(X=input, y=output[,x], nboot = 100, rank = FALSE))  src.result <- purrr::map(names(output), function(x) sensitivity::src(X=input, y=output[,x], nboot = 100, rank = FALSE)) plot(pcc.result[[1]]) pcc.result.tidy <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(pcc.result), function(x) {   pcc.result[[x]]$PCC %>%      tibble::rownames_to_column(var="parameter") %>%      dplyr::mutate(metric = names(output)[x]) })  ggplot(pcc.result.tidy) +   coord_flip() +   facet_wrap(~metric) +   geom_point(aes(x=parameter, y=original, color=metric)) +   geom_errorbar(aes(x=parameter, ymin=`min. c.i.`, ymax=`max. c.i.`, color=metric), width=0.1)  src.result.tidy <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(src.result), function(x) {   src.result[[x]]$SRC %>%      tibble::rownames_to_column(var="parameter") %>%      dplyr::mutate(metric = names(output)[x]) })  ggplot(src.result.tidy) +   coord_flip() +   facet_wrap(~metric) +   geom_point(aes(x=parameter, y=original, color=metric)) +   geom_errorbar(aes(x=parameter, ymin=`min. c.i.`, ymax=`max. c.i.`, color=metric), width=0.1)

"false" measurements taken last tick. evalticks applied tickmetrics = TRUE. Evalticks may contain vector integers, defining ticks defined metrics measured. Set evalticks NA_integer_ measure every tick. idsetup, idgo two class slots accept strings, vectors strings, defining NetLogo model procedures executed model setup (idsetup) model execution (idgo). runtime Defines maximum number simulation ticks executed. Use 0 NA_integer_ execute simulations without predefined number ticks. Warning: recommended combination stop condition (see slot stopcond), NetLogo models built-stop condition. Otherwise, simulations might get stuck endless loops. Depending simdesign, following slots may obligatory: metrics vector valid netlogo reporters defines measurements taken. optimization simdesigns need least one defined metrics reporter fitness calculation optimization algorithm. constants, variables slots accept lists NetLogo parameters varied within simdesign (variables) kept constant (constants) simulation. NetLogo parameter entered least one two lists set constant default value NetLogo interface. possible enter NetLogo parameter lists (warning message appear simdesign attached experiment). simdesigns except simdesign_simple need defined variables setting parameter matrix. Variables can defined distinct values, value distributions range increment. information needed, depends chosen simdesign (details variable definition requirements can found helpfiles simdesign helper function). remaining slots optional: expname character string defining name experiment, useful documentation purposes. string must contain whitespaces. outpath valid path existing directory. directory used write_simoutput function store attached simulation results disk csv format. idfinal character string vector strings defining NetLogo procedures executed end simulation (e.g. cleanup self-written output procedures). idrunnum slot can used transfer current nlrx experiment name, random seed runnumber (siminputrow) NetLogo. use functionality, string input field widget needs created GUI NetLogo model. name widget can entered "idrunnum" field experiment. simulations, value widget automatically updated generated string contains current nlrx experiment name, random seed siminputrow ("expname_seed_siminputrow"). self-written output NetLogo, suggest include global variable allows referencing self-written output files collected output nlrx simulations R. stopcond stopcond slot can used define stop condition providing string valid NetLogo code reports either true false. simulation stopped automatically, reporter reports true. metrics.patches metrics.patches slot accepts vector valid patches-variables NetLogo model. patch variables measured addition defined metrics. Results metrics nested inside output results tibble simulations. Please note NetLogo models may contain huge number patches output measurements agent variables tick may need lot ressources. metrics.turtles metrics.turtles slot accepts list named vectors valid turtle breed metrics. name vector list defines specified breed NetLogo model, whereas vector defines variables measured breed. example metrics.turtles = list("sheep"=c("color"), "wolves"=c("")) - measure color sheep number wolf agent. measure turtles-variables turtles, use "turtles" = c(...). aware, NetLogo produce runtime errors measure breed-variables agents belong breed. code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ ## Example running the Giant Component model from the NetLogo models library: library(nlrx) library(igraph) # Windows default NetLogo installation path (adjust to your needs!): netlogopath <- file.path("C:/Program Files/NetLogo 7.0.4") modelpath <- file.path(netlogopath, "models/Sample Models/Networks/Giant Component.nlogox") outpath <- file.path("C:/out") # Unix default NetLogo installation path (adjust to your needs!): netlogopath <- file.path("/home/NetLogo 7.0.4") modelpath <- file.path(netlogopath, "models/Sample Models/Networks/Giant Component.nlogox") outpath <- file.path("/home/out")  nl <- nl(nlversion = "7.0.4",          nlpath = netlogopath,          modelpath = modelpath,          jvmmem = 1024)  nl@experiment <- experiment(expname="networks",                             outpath=outpath,                             tickmetrics="false",                             idsetup="setup",                             idgo="go",                             runtime=50,                             metrics.turtles = list("turtles" = c("who", "color")),                             metrics.links = list("links" = c("[who] of end1", "[who] of end2")),                             constants = list("num-nodes" = 80,                                              "layout?" = TRUE))  nl@simdesign <- simdesign_simple(nl, 1) nl@simdesign@simoutput <- run_nl_all(nl) nl.graph <- nl_to_graph(nl)  ## Extract graph of tick 1: nl.graph.i <- nl.graph$spatial.links[[1]] ## Set vertex colors by measured color variable: vcols <- c("7" = "grey", "15" = "red") V(nl.graph.i)$color <- vcols[as.character(V(nl.graph.i)$color)] ## Set edge colors by measured link breed: ecols <- c("links" = "black") E(nl.graph.i)$color <- ecols[E(nl.graph.i)$breed]  ## Plot: plot.igraph(nl.graph.i, vertex.size=8, vertex.label=NA, edge.arrow.size=0.2)  } # }

title: nlrx 0.5.0
text: Support NetLogo versions prior 7.0.0 removed. NetLogo (>= 7.0.0) ‘logolink’ (>= 1.0.0) now required run simulations. legacy execution backend (OS-specific batch-file generation direct NetLogo calls) removed; execution delegated entirely ‘logolink’. NetLogo 7 introduced new model file format (.nlogox) converts widget sizes. Models created older NetLogo versions must opened re-saved NetLogo 7 can used nlrx. See NetLogo transition guide details: https://docs.netlogo.org/transition. nl(), report_model_parameters(), nldoc() run functions stop advice given .nlogo file. NetLogo 7 convert file fly, nlrx read old format check parameters. run_nl_all() longer parallelises ‘future’ package: future::plan() effect anymore. Simulations bundled blocks run one NetLogo instance , parallelised NetLogo’s native multithreading (threads, see New features). distribute simulations several machines, split simdesign chunks, shown ‘rslurm’ “Advanced configuration” article: https://docs.ropensci.org/nlrx/articles/furthernotes.html. repetition slot experiment class removed, together repetition argument experiment(). Repetitions executed NetLogo BehaviorSpace seeds nlrx neither controlled reported, repeated runs reproduced, one repetition results mapped back parameterisation reliably. Passing repetition = 1 still works emits deprecation warning effect; repetition > 1 error. Use nseeds simdesign helpers instead, nreplicates run_nl_dyn() dynamic designs. seed argument run_nl_dyn() deprecated. seeds simdesign used instead, run_nl_all(). Passing seed still works release emits deprecation warning; run subset seeds, reduce setsim(nl, "simseeds") <- .... Note return value run_nl_dyn() changed (see New features). NetLogo literals can longer used parameter values. Since ‘logolink’ quotes every character value offers escape hatch, value "[1 2 3]" reaches NetLogo string instead list. eval_variables_constants() reports values look like list literals; define globals within model instead. arguments split, cleanup.csv, cleanup.xml, cleanup.bat writeRDS deprecated longer effect (file handling managed ‘logolink’). Passing now emits deprecation warning. n_cluster argument ABC-MCMC simdesigns (simdesign_ABCmcmc_Marjoram(), simdesign_ABCmcmc_Marjoram_original(), simdesign_ABCmcmc_Wegmann()) removed. never parallelised simulations (always reset 1) now deprecated; passing emits deprecation warning.

title: nlrx 0.5.0
text: Added support NetLogo 7 newer (#106). simulation backend redesigned around ‘logolink’ package, generates BehaviorSpace XML executes NetLogo. Simulations now executed blocks (#60). run_nl_all() gains block_size (number simulations bundled one NetLogo instance) threads (NetLogo’s native multithreading) arguments. Bundling many simulations BehaviorSpace sub-experiments within single NetLogo instance avoids repeated JVM/NetLogo start-previous one-process-per-run approach, can substantially speed larger designs (#94, #95, #101). run_nl_one() now accepts vector random seeds executes parameterisation per seed. replicated runs executed within one NetLogo instance can parallelised threads. run_nl_dyn() now runs one complete optimization random seed simdesign, instead single one seed given argument (#88). results returned tibble one row per seed, holding seed result object respective optimization result list column. objects stored optimization packages return , summary plot functions still apply (results$result[[1]]). failing optimization longer discards results seeds: error stored result column warning names affected seeds. run_nl_dyn() gains nreplicates argument. parameterisation proposed dynamic simdesign (GenSA, GenAlg, ABCmcmc_*) simulated nreplicates times different random seeds, reduces simulation noise evaluation criterion. replicate seeds derived simdesign seed optimization identical across evaluations (common random numbers), stored. results aggregated two steps, first measured ticks run replicated runs, runs measured ticks weigh . nldoc() documents NetLogo 7 models (.nlogox). GUI elements read parser report_model_parameters(), BehaviorSpace section covers NetLogo 7 experiment definitions, including pre- post-experiment commands, measurement condition sub-experiments. toc number_sections options now also apply PDF output, rendering longer prints pandoc command line. nlpath optional. defaults NETLOGO_HOME environment variable, can omitted set, given path takes precedence: NETLOGO_HOME set duration run restored afterwards, different nl objects can use different NetLogo installations within one session. missing installation reported clear error, nlpath exist current system (example nl object restored import_nl()) warns falls back NETLOGO_HOME. simdesign_morris() gains scale argument. input factors always scaled [0,1] elementary effects computed; passing scale = FALSE now yields unscaled effects.

title: nlrx 0.5.0
text: run_nl_dyn() tells upfront many evaluations optimization seed may take shows progress. Every evaluation one NetLogo run, defaults dynamic simdesigns can take hours days (example 20,000 runs per seed simdesign_GenAlg()), looked like hanging session: run printed log lines without indication total. log lines single runs now held back shown run fails, progress bar counts evaluations, GenSA simdesign without stop criterion control produces warning. defaults unchanged; examples vignettes use settings finish within minutes. Untested NetLogo 7 versions longer rejected. nl() download_netlogo() now emit warning continue NetLogo version among versions nlrx tested (supported_netlogo_versions()): simulations executed ‘logolink’, newer releases likely work without nlrx update. Errors warnings setup (NetLogo version, model format, export path, dynamic simdesign settings) explain wrong , without call backtrace. String boolean parameter values expected plain character values logicals. ‘logolink’ quotes character values , one layer enclosing double quotes removed values constants variables, escaped-quote convention earlier nlrx versions ("model-version" = "\"sheep-wolves-grass\"") keeps working. Boolean strings ("false", "TRUE") converted logicals, constants well variables. nlrx longer depends ‘XML’ package; NetLogo model files read ‘xml2’. sample data sets (nl_lhs, nl_sobol, …) regenerated NetLogo 7.0.4.
